abstention_secondary: accept p>=0.8, reject p<=0.2, otherwise abstain; report class-specific and overall coverage
adaptation: common probability JSON schema and bounded context; not exact reproduction of original paper models or Harbor agent
artifact_packet: trusted read-only parsers of supplied OBJ/JSON and bounded trajectory error/test observations; no source code, shell command or artifact executed; missing snapshot is not original artifact absence
cohort: all 203 official evaluation trajectories from 14 source tasks; no label-based selection
context: task max12000 chars, trajectory max48000 chars retaining head/tail with explicit truncation, skills max12000 chars combined, official summary max12000; optional artifact facts max12000
design: same task, trajectory, available skill documents and official optional artifact summary; standard direct judge adaptation, same-material evidence rules, plus programmatic artifact packet
limits: verification of archived external trajectories, not new task-solving runs
14 source tasks, class imbalance, partial artifact snapshots
same model alias across arms; aliases may change
rule combination and artifact inspection are known mechanisms; no global novelty claim
primary: balanced accuracy for binary PASS/FAIL and task-macro balanced accuracy where both classes occur
probability: reported p_success, not assumed calibrated; PASS iff p_success>=0.5
selection_secondary: offline fixed rollout pools k=1,3,5,10, same candidate subsets per arm and first/random baseline; choose max p; 1000 deterministic seeded subsets per source task; compare ceiling; not live SkillNet optimization
statistics: paired bootstrap over 14 source-task clusters, 10000 resamples, descriptive conditional intervals; no population or novelty guarantee
test_labels: metadata trajectory_label/reward excluded from inference; scoring opens labels after predictions are immutable. Schema discovery viewed one example label and public aggregate class counts; not a blinded author study, no label-based case selection or prompt tuning
unknown_usage_or_infra_failure: stop new scheduling, preserve in-flight outputs and reservations
